My plan:\n\n- **Algorithm (exact):** keep a running max-distance per candidate instead of recomputing it against all members each step, and drop candidates whose diameter already reached the threshold (they can never become eligible again). This yields identical choices with far less work.\n- **MPI:** distribute seed evaluation round-robin across ranks, pick the global winner (max cardinality, lowest seed index, same as the serial tie-break), broadcast its members, and keep every rank's state in sync.\n- **Validation:** distribute per-cluster diameter computation; print only on rank 0.\n\nWriting the new source now.","time":{"start":1792996607104,"end":1792996607262}}}
{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792996627509,"sessionID":"ses_e89156ff1ffeWvXl2Utrp4dDXF","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01MU5yKYXfxP6D3Cm9GsfBda","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/qtclustering_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - MPI Distributed Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy (distributed memory, MPI):\n//   * Every rank generates the same synthetic dataset (deterministic seed),\n//     so no point data needs to be communicated.\n//   * In each round, the candidate seeds (unclustered points, in ascending\n//     index order) are distributed round-robin across ranks. Each rank grows\n//     a candidate cluster for each of its seeds and keeps its best one.\n//   * The global winner is chosen with the same rule as the serial algorithm:\n//     maximum cardinality, ties broken by the lowest seed index. The winning\n//     rank broadcasts the cluster members, and all ranks update their state\n//     identically.\n//   * Validation diameters are computed in parallel and reduced to all ranks;\n//     only rank 0 produces output.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Result of growing a candidate cluster from one seed, exchanged between ranks\nstruct SeedResult {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters (deterministic)\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Scratch buffers reused across seed evaluations to avoid reallocation.\nstruct GrowScratch {\n    // Candidates that can still be added (ascending point index), and for each\n    // candidate the maximum distance to the current cluster members.\n    // Candidates whose maximum distance reached the threshold are dropped:\n    // that value never decreases, so they can never be selected again.\n    std::vector<int> cand;\n    std::vector<double> maxdist;\n};\n\n// Grow a candidate cluster from `seed` over the unclustered points.\n// Equivalent to repeatedly picking the unclustered candidate with the smallest\n// maximum distance to the members (ties -> lowest index) while that distance is\n// below the threshold. Returns the cardinality; members are written to `members`\n// in insertion order.\nint growCluster(const int seed,\n                const std::vector<int>& unclustered,\n                const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                const double threshold,\n                GrowScratch& s,\n                std::vector<int>& members) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    s.cand.clear();\n    s.maxdist.clear();\n    const Point& seed_pt = points[seed];\n    for (int c : unclustered) {\n        if (c == seed) continue;\n        const double d = distance(points[c], seed_pt);\n        if (d < threshold) {\n            s.cand.push_back(c);\n            s.maxdist.push_back(d);\n        }\n    }\n\n    while (!s.cand.empty()) {\n        // Select the candidate with minimal maximum-distance (first index on ties).\n        // All entries satisfy maxdist < threshold by construction.\n        size_t best = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 1; j < s.maxdist.size(); ++j) {\n            if (s.maxdist[j] < s.maxdist[best]) best = j;\n        }\n\n        const int chosen = s.cand[best];\n        members.push_back(chosen);\n        s.cand.erase(s.cand.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(best));\n        s.maxdist.erase(s.maxdist.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(best));\n\n        // Update maximum distances with the newly added member and prune candidates\n        // that can no longer satisfy the threshold.\n        const Point& chosen_pt = points[chosen];\n        size_t w = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < s.cand.size(); ++j) {\n            const double d = std::max(s.maxdist[j], distance(points[s.cand[j]], chosen_pt));\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                s.cand[w] = s.cand[j];\n                s.maxdist[w] = d;\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        s.cand.resize(w);\n        s.maxdist.resize(w);\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (distributed over MPI ranks).\n// Must be called collectively by all ranks; every rank returns the same result.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered[i] = i;\n    }\n\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    GrowScratch scratch;\n    std::vector<int> trial_members;\n    std::vector<int> local_best_members;\n    std::vector<SeedResult> all_results(nprocs);\n\n    while (!unclustered.empty()) {\n        const int remaining = static_cast<int>(unclustered.size());\n\n        // Evaluate this rank's share of seeds (round-robin over the unclustered list)\n        SeedResult local{-1, -1};\n        local_best_members.clear();\n        for (size_t pos = static_cast<size_t>(rank); pos < unclustered.size();\n             pos += static_cast<size_t>(nprocs)) {\n            const int seed = unclustered[pos];\n            const int cardinality = growCluster(seed, unclustered, points, threshold,\n                                                scratch, trial_members);\n            // Strictly greater: the first (lowest index) seed wins ties\n            if (cardinality > local.cardinality) {\n                local.cardinality = cardinality;\n                local.seed = seed;\n                local_best_members.swap(trial_members);\n            }\n            // No seed can exceed the number of remaining points\n            if (local.cardinality == remaining) break;\n        }\n\n        // Share the local bests and select the global winner\n        MPI_Allgather(&local, 2, MPI_INT, all_results.data(), 2, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        int best_rank = 0;\n        for (int r = 1; r < nprocs; ++r) {\n            const SeedResult& cand = all_results[r];\n            const SeedResult& cur = all_results[best_rank];\n            if (cand.cardinality > cur.cardinality ||\n                (cand.cardinality == cur.cardinality && cand.seed >= 0 && cand.seed < cur.seed)) {\n                best_rank = r;\n            }\n        }\n        const SeedResult best = all_results[best_rank];\n\n        if (best.seed < 0 || best.cardinality <= 0) {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n\n        // Broadcast the winning cluster's members from the owning rank\n        int n = (rank == best_rank) ? static_cast<int>(local_best_members.size()) : 0;\n        MPI_Bcast(&n, 1, MPI_INT, best_rank, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        std::vector<int> members;\n        if (rank == best_rank) {\n            members = local_best_members;\n        } else {\n            members.resize(n);\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(members.data(), n, MPI_INT, best_rank, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best.seed;\n        cluster.members = std::move(members);\n\n        for (int m : cluster.members) {\n            clustered[m] = 1;\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list (order preserved)\n        unclustered.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),\n                           [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered.end());\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties.\n// Collective: diameters are computed in parallel and reduced to all ranks.\n// Only rank 0 prints. Returns the same result on all ranks.\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                      const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                      const double threshold,\n                      const int rank,\n                      const int nprocs) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Diameter per cluster (max distance between any two members), computed in parallel\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t c = static_cast<size_t>(rank); c < clusters.size();\n         c += static_cast<size_t>(nprocs)) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                             points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n    if (!diameters.empty()) {\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, diameters.data(), static_cast<int>(diameters.size()),\n                      MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (rank == 0 && c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                       c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            }\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                if (rank == 0) {\n                    printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                           member, membership[member], c);\n                }\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n               points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    }\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Benchmark driver. Executed by all ranks; output is produced by rank 0 only.\n// Returns the process exit code (identical on all ranks).\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int nprocs) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", nprocs);\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, nprocs);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        // Remaining work is output/validation on rank 0, except for the\n        // collective validation step which all ranks must join.\n        if (validate) {\n            const bool valid = validateClusters(clusters, points, threshold, rank, nprocs);\n            return valid ? 0 : 1;\n        }\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n\n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n    printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n           total_clustered, num_points,\n           100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n    printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n    // Performance metrics\n    const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n    const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n           clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n                membership[clusters[c].members[i]] = static_cast<int>(c);\n            }\n        }\n        for (int m : membership) {\n            membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n        }\n        print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        const bool valid = validateClusters(clusters, points, threshold, rank, nprocs);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc,
